verses.original: אֵיכָה֩ אֲדֹנָי֙ אֶת־ יָעִ֨יב בַּת־ צִיּ֔וֹן בְּאַפּ֤וֹ׀ הִשְׁלִ֤יךְ תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ אֶ֔רֶץ וְלֹא־ זָכַ֥ר הֲדֹם־ רַגְלָ֖יו בְּי֥וֹם אַפּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ê·ḵāh ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’eṯ- yā·‘îḇ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn bə·’ap·pōw hiš·lîḵ tip̄·’e·reṯ yiś·rā·’êl miš·šā·ma·yim ’e·reṣ wə·lō- zā·ḵar hă·ḏōm- raḡ·lāw bə·yō·wm ’ap·pōw
verses.literal: How the Lord - has covered the Daughter of Zion with the cloud of His anger He has cast the glory of Israel from heaven to earth He has abandoned . . . His footstool . . . in the day of His anger

verses.original: לֹא חָמַ֗ל אֵ֚ת אֲדֹנָ֜י בִּלַּ֨ע כָּל־ נְא֣וֹת יַעֲקֹ֔ב בְּעֶבְרָת֛וֹ הָרַ֧ס מִבְצְרֵ֥י בַת־ יְהוּדָ֖ה הִגִּ֣יעַ לָאָ֑רֶץ חִלֵּ֥ל מַמְלָכָ֖ה וְשָׂרֶֽיהָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō ḥā·mal ’êṯ ’ă·ḏō·nāy bil·la‘ kāl- nə·’ō·wṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ bə·‘eḇ·rā·ṯōw hā·ras miḇ·ṣə·rê ḇaṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh hig·gî·a‘ lā·’ā·reṣ ḥil·lêl mam·lā·ḵāh wə·śā·re·hā
verses.literal: Without pity - the Lord has swallowed up all the dwellings of Jacob In His wrath He has demolished the fortified cities of the Daughter of Judah He brought to the ground and defiled her kingdom and its princes

verses.original: בָּֽחֳרִי אַ֗ף גָּדַ֣ע כֹּ֚ל קֶ֣רֶן יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הֵשִׁ֥יב אָח֛וֹר יְמִינ֖וֹ מִפְּנֵ֣י אוֹיֵ֑ב וַיִּבְעַ֤ר בְּיַעֲקֹב֙ לֶֽהָבָ֔ה כְּאֵ֣שׁ אָכְלָ֖ה סָבִֽיב׃ס
verses.transliteration: bå̄·ḥo·rī ’ap̄ gā·ḏa‘ kōl qe·ren yiś·rā·’êl hê·šîḇ ’ā·ḥō·wr yə·mî·nōw mip·pə·nê ’ō·w·yêḇ way·yiḇ·‘ar bə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ le·hā·ḇāh kə·’êš ’ā·ḵə·lāh sā·ḇîḇ
verses.literal: In fierce anger He has cut off every horn of Israel [and] withdrawn . . . His right hand at the approach of the enemy He has burned in Jacob like a flaming fire that consumes everything around it

verses.original: דָּרַ֨ךְ קַשְׁתּ֜וֹ כְּאוֹיֵ֗ב יְמִינוֹ֙ נִצָּ֤ב כְּצָ֔ר וַֽיַּהֲרֹ֔ג כֹּ֖ל מַחֲמַדֵּי־ עָ֑יִן שָׁפַ֥ךְ חֲמָתֽוֹ׃ס כָּאֵ֖שׁ בְּאֹ֙הֶל֙ בַּת־ צִיּ֔וֹן
verses.transliteration: dā·raḵ qaš·tōw kə·’ō·w·yêḇ yə·mî·nōw niṣ·ṣāḇ kə·ṣār way·ya·hă·rōḡ kōl ma·ḥă·mad·dê- ‘ā·yin šā·p̄aḵ ḥă·mā·ṯōw kā·’êš bə·’ō·hel baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn
verses.literal: He has bent His bow like an enemy His right hand is positioned Like a foe He has killed all who were pleasing to the eye He has poured out His wrath like fire on the tent of the Daughter of Zion

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֤י׀ הָיָ֨ה כְּאוֹיֵב֙ בִּלַּ֣ע יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בִּלַּע֙ כָּל־ אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ שִׁחֵ֖ת מִבְצָרָ֑יו וַיֶּ֙רֶב֙ תַּאֲנִיָּ֖ה וַאֲנִיָּֽה׃ס בְּבַת־ יְהוּדָ֔ה
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy hā·yāh kə·’ō·w·yêḇ bil·la‘ yiś·rā·’êl bil·la‘ kāl- ’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯe·hā ši·ḥêṯ miḇ·ṣā·rāw way·ye·reḇ ta·’ă·nî·yāh wa·’ă·nî·yāh bə·ḇaṯ- yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: The Lord is like an enemy He has swallowed up Israel He has swallowed up all her palaces and destroyed her strongholds He has multiplied mourning and lamentation for the Daughter of Judah

verses.original: וַיַּחְמֹ֤ס שֻׂכּ֔וֹ כַּגַּן֙ שִׁחֵ֖ת מוֹעֲד֑וֹ יְהוָ֤ה׀ שִׁכַּ֨ח בְּצִיּוֹן֙ מוֹעֵ֣ד וְשַׁבָּ֔ת בְּזַֽעַם־ אַפּ֖וֹ וַיִּנְאַ֥ץ מֶ֥לֶךְ וְכֹהֵֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yaḥ·mōs śuk·kōw kag·gan ši·ḥêṯ mō·w·‘ă·ḏōw Yah·weh šik·kaḥ bə·ṣî·yō·wn mō·w·‘êḏ wə·šab·bāṯ bə·za·‘am- ’ap·pōw way·yin·’aṣ me·leḵ wə·ḵō·hên
verses.literal: He has laid waste His tabernacle like a garden booth He has destroyed His place of meeting The LORD has made Zion forget . . . her appointed feasts and Sabbaths In His fierce anger . . . He has despised [both] king and priest

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֤י׀ זָנַ֨ח מִזְבְּחוֹ֙ נִאֵ֣ר מִקְדָּשׁ֔וֹ הִסְגִּיר֙ חוֹמֹ֖ת אַרְמְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ בְּיַד־ אוֹיֵ֔ב נָתְנ֥וּ ק֛וֹל בְּבֵית־ יְהוָ֖ה כְּי֥וֹם מוֹעֵֽד׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḏō·nāy zā·naḥ miz·bə·ḥōw ni·’êr miq·dā·šōw his·gîr ḥō·w·mōṯ ’ar·mə·nō·w·ṯe·hā bə·yaḏ- ’ō·w·yêḇ nā·ṯə·nū qō·wl bə·ḇêṯ- Yah·weh kə·yō·wm mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: The Lord has rejected His altar He has abandoned His sanctuary He has delivered the walls of her palaces into the hand of the enemy They have raised a shout in the house of the LORD as on the day of an appointed feast

verses.original: יְהוָ֤ה׀ חָשַׁ֨ב לְהַשְׁחִית֙ חוֹמַ֣ת בַּת־ צִיּ֔וֹן נָ֣טָה קָ֔ו לֹא־ הֵשִׁ֥יב יָד֖וֹ מִבַּלֵּ֑עַ חֵ֥ל וְחוֹמָ֖ה וַיַּֽאֲבֶל־ יַחְדָּ֥ו אֻמְלָֽלוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ḥā·šaḇ lə·haš·ḥîṯ ḥō·w·maṯ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn nā·ṭāh qāw lō- hê·šîḇ yā·ḏōw mib·bal·lê·a‘ ḥêl wə·ḥō·w·māh way·ya·’ă·ḇel- yaḥ·dāw ’um·lā·lū
verses.literal: The LORD determined to destroy the wall of the Daughter of Zion He stretched out a measuring line and did not withdraw His hand from destroying He made the ramparts and walls lament together they waste away

verses.original: שְׁעָרֶ֔יהָ טָבְע֤וּ בָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אִבַּ֥ד וְשִׁבַּ֖ר בְּרִיחֶ֑יהָ מַלְכָּ֨הּ וְשָׂרֶ֤יהָ בַגּוֹיִם֙ תּוֹרָ֔ה אֵ֣ין גַּם־ נְבִיאֶ֕יהָ מָצְא֥וּ לֹא־ חָז֖וֹן מֵיְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: šə·‘ā·re·hā ṭā·ḇə·‘ū ḇā·’ā·reṣ ’ib·baḏ wə·šib·bar bə·rî·ḥe·hā mal·kāh wə·śā·re·hā ḇag·gō·w·yim tō·w·rāh ’ên gam- nə·ḇî·’e·hā mā·ṣə·’ū lō- ḥā·zō·wn Yah·weh
verses.literal: Her gates have sunk into the ground He has destroyed and shattered their bars Her king and her princes are [exiled] among the nations the law is no more and even her prophets find no vision from the LORD

verses.original: זִקְנֵ֣י בַת־ צִיּ֔וֹן יֵשְׁב֨וּ לָאָ֤רֶץ יִדְּמוּ֙ הֶֽעֱל֤וּ עָפָר֙ עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֔ם חָגְר֖וּ שַׂקִּ֑ים בְּתוּלֹ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃ס הוֹרִ֤ידוּ רֹאשָׁ֔ן לָאָ֙רֶץ֙
verses.transliteration: ziq·nê ḇaṯ- ṣî·yō·wn yê·šə·ḇū lā·’ā·reṣ yid·də·mū he·‘ĕ·lū ‘ā·p̄ār ‘al- rō·šām ḥā·ḡə·rū śaq·qîm bə·ṯū·lōṯ yə·rū·šā·lim hō·w·rî·ḏū rō·šān lā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: The elders of the Daughter of Zion sit on the ground in silence They have thrown dust on their heads and put on sackcloth The young women of Jerusalem have bowed their heads to the ground

verses.original: עֵינַי֙ כָּל֨וּ בַדְּמָע֤וֹת חֳמַרְמְר֣וּ מֵעַ֔י כְּבֵדִ֔י נִשְׁפַּ֤ךְ לָאָ֙רֶץ֙ עַל־ שֶׁ֖בֶר בַּת־ עַמִּ֑י עוֹלֵל֙ וְיוֹנֵ֔ק בֵּֽעָטֵ֤ף בִּרְחֹב֖וֹת קִרְיָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·nay kā·lū ḇad·də·mā·‘ō·wṯ ḥo·mar·mə·rū mê·‘ay kə·ḇê·ḏî niš·paḵ lā·’ā·reṣ ‘al- še·ḇer baṯ- ‘am·mî ‘ō·w·lêl wə·yō·w·nêq bê·‘ā·ṭêp̄ bir·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ qir·yāh
verses.literal: My eyes fail from weeping I am churning within My heart is poured out in grief over the destruction of the daughter of my people because children and infants faint in the streets of the city

verses.original: יֹֽאמְר֔וּ לְאִמֹּתָם֙ אַיֵּ֖ה דָּגָ֣ן וָיָ֑יִן בְּהִֽתְעַטְּפָ֤ם כֶּֽחָלָל֙ בִּרְחֹב֣וֹת עִ֔יר נַפְשָׁ֔ם בְּהִשְׁתַּפֵּ֣ךְ אֶל־ חֵ֖יק אִמֹּתָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: yō·mə·rū lə·’im·mō·ṯām ’ay·yêh dā·ḡān wā·yā·yin bə·hiṯ·‘aṭ·ṭə·p̄ām ke·ḥā·lāl bir·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ ‘îr nap̄·šām bə·hiš·tap·pêḵ ’el- ḥêq ’im·mō·ṯām
verses.literal: They cry out to their mothers Where is the grain and wine as they faint like the wounded in the streets of the city as their lives fade away in the arms of their mothers

verses.original: מָֽה־ אֲעִידֵ֞ךְ לָּ֗ךְ מָ֣ה אֲדַמֶּה־ הַבַּת֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם לָּךְ֙ מָ֤ה אַשְׁוֶה־ וַאֲנַֽחֲמֵ֔ךְ בְּתוּלַ֖ת בַּת־ צִיּ֑וֹן כִּֽי־ שִׁבְרֵ֖ךְ גָד֥וֹל כַּיָּ֛ם מִ֥י יִרְפָּא־ לָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: māh- ’ă·‘î·ḏêḵ lāḵ māh ’ă·ḏam·meh- hab·baṯ yə·rū·šā·lim lāḵ māh ’aš·weh- wa·’ă·na·ḥă·mêḵ bə·ṯū·laṯ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn kî- šiḇ·rêḵ ḡā·ḏō·wl kay·yām mî yir·pā- lāḵ
verses.literal: What can I say for you To what can I compare you O Daughter of Jerusalem To what can I liken you that I may console you O Virgin Daughter of Zion For your wound is as deep as the sea Who can ever heal you

verses.original: חָ֤זוּ נְבִיאַ֗יִךְ לָךְ֙ שָׁ֣וְא וְתָפֵ֔ל וְלֹֽא־ גִלּ֥וּ עַל־ עֲוֺנֵ֖ךְ לְהָשִׁ֣יב שְׁבִיתֵךְ מַשְׂא֥וֹת וַיֶּ֣חֱזוּ לָ֔ךְ שָׁ֖וְא וּמַדּוּחִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zū nə·ḇî·’a·yiḵ lāḵ šāw wə·ṯā·p̄êl wə·lō- ḡil·lū ‘al- ‘ă·wō·nêḵ lə·hā·šîḇ šə·ḇī·ṯēḵ maś·’ō·wṯ way·ye·ḥĕ·zū lāḵ šāw ū·mad·dū·ḥîm
verses.literal: The visions of your prophets were empty and deceptive they did not expose . . . your guilt to ward off your captivity The burdens they envisioned for you were empty and misleading

verses.original: כָּל־ עֹ֣בְרֵי דֶ֔רֶךְ סָֽפְק֨וּ כַּפַּ֙יִם֙ עָלַ֤יִךְ שָֽׁרְקוּ֙ וַיָּנִ֣עוּ רֹאשָׁ֔ם עַל־ בַּ֖ת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הֲזֹ֣את הָעִ֗יר שֶׁיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ כְּלִ֣ילַת יֹ֔פִי מָשׂ֖וֹשׂ לְכָל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- ‘ō·ḇə·rê ḏe·reḵ sā·p̄ə·qū kap·pa·yim ‘ā·la·yiḵ šā·rə·qū way·yā·ni·‘ū rō·šām ‘al- baṯ yə·rū·šā·lim hă·zōṯ hā·‘îr še·yō·mə·rū kə·lî·laṯ yō·p̄î mā·śō·wś lə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: All who pass by . . . clap their hands at you [in scorn] They hiss and shake their heads at the Daughter of Jerusalem Is this the city that was called the perfection of beauty the joy of all the earth

verses.original: כָּל־ א֣וֹיְבַ֔יִךְ פָּצ֨וּ פִּיהֶם֙ עָלַ֤יִךְ שָֽׁרְקוּ֙ וַיַּֽחַרְקוּ־ שֵׁ֔ן אָמְר֖וּ בִּלָּ֑עְנוּ אַ֣ךְ זֶ֥ה הַיּ֛וֹם שֶׁקִּוִּינֻ֖הוּ מָצָ֥אנוּ רָאִֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’ō·wy·ḇa·yiḵ pā·ṣū pî·hem ‘ā·la·yiḵ šā·rə·qū way·ya·ḥar·qū- šên ’ā·mə·rū bil·lā·‘ə·nū ’aḵ zeh hay·yō·wm šeq·qiw·wî·nu·hū mā·ṣā·nū rā·’î·nū
verses.literal: All your enemies open their mouths against you They hiss and gnash their teeth saying We have swallowed her up . . . This is the day for which we have waited We have lived to see it

verses.original: יְהוָ֜ה עָשָׂ֨ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר זָמָ֗ם בִּצַּ֤ע אֶמְרָתוֹ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוָּ֣ה מִֽימֵי־ קֶ֔דֶם הָרַ֖ס וְלֹ֣א חָמָ֑ל אוֹיֵ֔ב וַיְשַׂמַּ֤ח עָלַ֙יִךְ֙ הֵרִ֖ים קֶ֥רֶן צָרָֽיִךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ‘ā·śāh ’ă·šer zā·mām biṣ·ṣa‘ ’em·rā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ṣiw·wāh mî·mê- qe·ḏem hā·ras wə·lō ḥā·māl ’ō·w·yêḇ way·śam·maḥ ‘ā·la·yiḵ hê·rîm qe·ren ṣā·rā·yiḵ
verses.literal: The LORD has done what He planned He has accomplished His decree which He ordained in days of old He has overthrown you without pity He has let the enemy gloat over you and exalted the horn of your foes

verses.original: לִבָּ֖ם צָעַ֥ק אֶל־ אֲדֹנָ֑י חוֹמַ֣ת בַּת־ צִ֠יּוֹן דִּמְעָה֙ הוֹרִ֨ידִי כַנַּ֤חַל יוֹמָ֣ם וָלַ֔יְלָה תִּתְּנִ֤י לָ֔ךְ אַֽל־ פוּגַת֙ עֵינֵֽךְ׃ס בַּת־ אַל־ תִּדֹּ֖ם
verses.transliteration: lib·bām ṣā·‘aq ’el- ’ă·ḏō·nāy ḥō·w·maṯ baṯ- ṣî·yō·wn dim·‘āh hō·w·rî·ḏî ḵan·na·ḥal yō·w·mām wā·lay·lāh tit·tə·nî lāḵ ’al- p̄ū·ḡaṯ ‘ê·nêḵ baṯ- ’al- tid·dōm
verses.literal: The hearts [of the people] cry out to the Lord O wall of the Daughter of Zion let your tears run down like a river day and night Give yourself no relief and your eyes . . . no rest

verses.original: ק֣וּמִי׀ רֹ֣נִּי בַלַּיִל לְרֹאשׁ֙ אַשְׁמֻר֔וֹת שִׁפְכִ֤י לִבֵּ֔ךְ כַמַּ֙יִם֙ נֹ֖כַח פְּנֵ֣י אֲדֹנָ֑י שְׂאִ֧י כַּפַּ֗יִךְ אֵלָ֣יו עַל־ נֶ֙פֶשׁ֙ עֽוֹלָלַ֔יִךְ הָעֲטוּפִ֥ים בְּרָעָ֖ב בְּרֹ֥אשׁ כָּל־ חוּצֽוֹת׃ס
verses.transliteration: qū·mî rōn·nî ḇal·la·yil lə·rōš ’aš·mu·rō·wṯ šip̄·ḵî lib·bêḵ ḵam·ma·yim nō·ḵaḥ pə·nê ’ă·ḏō·nāy śə·’î kap·pa·yiḵ ’ê·lāw ‘al- ne·p̄eš ‘ō·w·lā·la·yiḵ hā·‘ă·ṭū·p̄îm bə·rā·‘āḇ bə·rōš kāl- ḥū·ṣō·wṯ
verses.literal: Arise cry out in the night from the first watch of the night Pour out your heart like water in the presence of the Lord Lift up your hands to Him for the lives of your children who are fainting from hunger on the corner of every street

verses.original: רְאֵ֤ה יְהוָה֙ וְֽהַבִּ֔יטָה לְמִ֖י עוֹלַ֣לְתָּ כֹּ֑ה אִם־ נָשִׁ֤ים תֹּאכַ֨לְנָה פִּרְיָם֙ עֹלֲלֵ֣י טִפֻּחִ֔ים כֹּהֵ֥ן וְנָבִֽיא׃ס יֵהָרֵ֛ג בְּמִקְדַּ֥שׁ אֲדֹנָ֖י אִם־
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh Yah·weh wə·hab·bî·ṭāh lə·mî ‘ō·w·lal·tā kōh ’im- nā·šîm tō·ḵal·nāh pir·yām ‘ō·lă·lê ṭip·pu·ḥîm kō·hên wə·nā·ḇî yê·hā·rêḡ bə·miq·daš ’ă·ḏō·nāy ’im-
verses.literal: Look O LORD and consider Whom have You [ever] treated like this Should women eat their offspring the infants they have nurtured Should priests and prophets be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord . . .

verses.original: נַ֣עַר וְזָקֵ֔ן שָׁכְב֨וּ לָאָ֤רֶץ חוּצוֹת֙ וּבַחוּרַ֖י בְּתוּלֹתַ֥י נָפְל֣וּ בֶחָ֑רֶב הָרַ֙גְתָּ֙ בְּי֣וֹם אַפֶּ֔ךָ טָבַ֖חְתָּ לֹ֥א חָמָֽלְתָּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: na·‘ar wə·zā·qên šā·ḵə·ḇū lā·’ā·reṣ ḥū·ṣō·wṯ ū·ḇa·ḥū·ray bə·ṯū·lō·ṯay nā·p̄ə·lū ḇe·ḥā·reḇ hā·raḡ·tā bə·yō·wm ’ap·pe·ḵā ṭā·ḇaḥ·tā lō ḥā·mā·lə·tā
verses.literal: Both young and old lie together in the dust of the streets My young men and maidens have fallen by the sword You have slain [them] in the day of Your anger You have slaughtered [them] without compassion

verses.original: תִּקְרָא֩ מְגוּרַי֙ מִסָּבִ֔יב כְי֨וֹם מוֹעֵ֤ד בְּי֥וֹם יְהוָ֖ה אַף־ וְלֹ֥א הָיָ֛ה פָּלִ֣יט וְשָׂרִ֑יד אֹיְבִ֥י כִלָּֽם׃פ אֲשֶׁר־ טִפַּ֥חְתִּי וְרִבִּ֖יתִי
verses.transliteration: tiq·rā mə·ḡū·ray mis·sā·ḇîḇ ḵə·yō·wm mō·w·‘êḏ bə·yō·wm Yah·weh ’ap̄- wə·lō hā·yāh pā·lîṭ wə·śā·rîḏ ’ō·yə·ḇî ḵil·lām ’ă·šer- ṭip·paḥ·tî wə·rib·bî·ṯî
verses.literal: You summoned my terrors on every side as for the day of an appointed feast In the day of the LORD’s anger no . . . one escaped or survived my enemy has destroyed those I nurtured and reared
